rows.en:
(Sounds like an order came in from the New U.N.
Forces. I wonder what kind of mission it is?)
Looks like everyone's here.
Then let's begin the mission briefing.

This mission is to destroy and investigate
a Vajra nest that's been discovered.

To stop the Vajra from multiplying, I want you
to destroy as many Vajra eggs as you can.
rows.notes: Cathy's request (-te choudai) to the pilots.

rows.en:
Your mission also includes bringing back
samples for analysis.

I understand the mission outline.
But a mission inside a Vajra nest means...

Yes, there's a good chance the Vajra will show up.
Carry out the demolition and survey carefully.

(So this mission is to destroy and investigate
a Vajra nest...)
Leave the backup to me, Alto.
Yeah, I'm counting on you, 'Michel.'
rows.notes: Alto; the Japanese sets the name off in quotes because he used to insist on 'Michael' (c24050).

rows.en:
(Huh? Alto and Michel seem to be getting
along even better than before...?)

Hold on!
Alto... you just called him Michel, didn't you!?

You always stubbornly called him 'Michael'
before...
rows.notes: Shared male/female; player to Alto. Mihaeru = Michael (glossary en Michael Blanc), the formal name Alto used to use.

rows.en:
Wh-who cares about that!?
C'mon, let's hurry up and get ready to sortie!!
Geez, wait up, Alto.

Heh heh. Come on, let's get ready to sortie too,
\p-san.
(I really wonder what happened between those two...)

(But right now I need to focus on the mission.
Okay, let's do this!)

(Sounds like an order came in from the New U.N.
Forces. I wonder what kind of mission it is?)

(So this mission is to destroy and investigate
a Vajra nest...)

(Huh? Saotome-kun and Michel-kun seem to be
getting along even better than before...?)

Hold on!
Saotome-kun... you just called him Michel,
didn't you!?

(But right now I need to focus on the mission.
Okay, let's do this!)

Oh, good work to you too,
Cathy-san.
rows.notes: Shared male/female; reply to Cathy's 'otsukaresama' (c24066 / c20863).

rows.en:
We may get another request.
I'll be counting on you when we do.
Understood!

(Phew... We managed to intercept the Vajra,
but I wasn't much help...)
rows.notes: Subject 'we' restored for the interception (team effort).

rows.en: (Phew... I'm glad we managed to intercept the Vajra.)
Good work, \p-san.

(Michel told me the rebellion on Gallia 4, where
Sheryl and the others were taken hostage, had
been put down safely, so I was relieved, but...)

(But after that, all contact was cut off...
What on earth is happening on Gallia 4?)

Multiple defold reactions detected
in the space dead ahead of the Frontier fleet!

A huge swarm of Vajra has appeared, including
several carrier-class! Pilots, sortie immediately!

(Damn it! Why do the Vajra have to show up now,
when Alto and Michel aren't here...!)

We can't let the Vajra get
any closer to Frontier!
We're sortieing as a mobile strike force!
I'll show them... I'll show them I can do it too!
rows.notes: Luca, keyed up (boku datte yatte yaru).

rows.en:
(Luca seems awfully wound up about something.
Is he going to be okay?)
All right! We're heading out too!

(We can't let the Vajra get
any closer to Frontier!)

(Michel-kun told me the rebellion on Gallia 4,
where Sheryl and the others were taken hostage,
had been put down safely, so I was relieved, but...)

(But after that, all contact was cut off...
What on earth is happening on Gallia 4?)

(Why do the Vajra have to show up now, when
Saotome-kun and Michel-kun aren't here...!)

(Luca-kun seems awfully wound up about something.
I wonder if he'll be okay...)

(We can't let the Vajra get
any closer to Frontier!)

Looks like Ranka was rescued safely
from the Vajra ship, too.
So she's safe. Thank goodness...

Huh? Captain Klan,
what's the big hurry?
rows.notes: Shared male/female; Kuran taii = Captain Klan.

rows.en: I-I'm not in any hurry!

I just heard Michel got hurt, so I was thinking
I'd go visit him, that's all...

S-sorry, but I'll be taking my leave now.
It's not like I'm dying to see that Michel's okay
or anything! Don't get the wrong idea!

Yes, yes, I get it.
Just hurry up and go visit Michel.
(I should go visit Michel too...)

(We managed to protect Frontier from the Vajra,
but I wasn't much help...)

Yes, yes, I get it.
Just hurry up and go visit Michel-kun.
(I should go visit Michel-kun too...)

(Well, I'm off duty today.
Maybe I'll go out somewhere...)
Got a minute, \p-kun?

Huh? Oh, sure.
What is it, Cathy-san?

It's an order for a top-secret mission.
Listen with that in mind.
A top-secret mission?

Yes. You'll get the details at the briefing, but
apparently it's escort duty for an experiment
using Ranka-san's singing...
Escorting Ranka...?
This mission is escort duty for Ranka.

What do you mean, an experiment using
Ranka's singing, Major Ozma?

The brass seem to think that letting the Vajra hear
Ranka's singing will have some kind of effect.
A Minmay Attack on the Vajra...

Damn it, sending Ranka onto the battlefield
for something nobody can even prove...!

There's only one thing we can do!
Don't let those Vajra lay a single finger on Ranka!!
Let's go!

(Making the Vajra listen to a song... What on earth
is the Frontier government thinking?)
(I have to protect Ranka, no matter what!)

(Well, I'm off duty today.
Maybe I'll go out somewhere...)
Got a minute, \p-san?
Escorting Ranka-chan...?

What do you mean, an experiment using
Ranka-chan's singing, Major Ozma?

(Making the Vajra listen to a song... What on earth
is the Frontier government thinking?)
(I have to protect Ranka-chan, no matter what!)

(I wasn't much use
as Ranka's escort...)

(Phew... Somehow I managed to do my job
as Ranka's escort.)
